title: The influence of extroversion and introversion personality types on the acceptance of virtual learning during the COVID-19 pandemic
descriptions: This study was mainly descriptive with open-ended questions used to gain insight on how two diametrically opposite personalities, namely extroverts and introverts differ in their acceptance of fully virtual learning classes. The data set and the consent form are deposited here.
